rows.label: Overseas pace
cells: Scale up once the model works

components.text: In August, Mixue's management said store count is no longer its primary target.

footnote: Source: Mixue Group interim earnings call (Aug 2026)
notes: Planning by store count assumes a new store brings in roughly what an old one does. That no longer holds. Planning by same-store growth still allows openings, but each one must first show it will not eat into nearby stores. Guming's management has made the same point: a wave of weak stores dilutes the business of existing franchisees.
